# GitHub Copilot — rocprofiler-compute

Follow the project’s **`.ai/`** tree (single source of truth):

| Use | Path |
|-----|------|
| Hard constraints | `.ai/rules/core.md`, `.ai/rules/anti_patterns.md`, `.ai/rules/profiling_infra.md` |
| Style / conventions | `.ai/standards/python.md`, `.ai/standards/cpp.md`, `.ai/standards/cmake.md` |
| What to do this task | `.ai/skills/index.md` → one skill file |
| Opening prompt | `.ai/prompts/default.md` |

Validate with **ruff** + **pytest** (Python) or **CMake** out-of-source build (native). See `pyproject.toml` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
